faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NAM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NAM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Multi Purpose Health Worker (MPHW).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NAM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (www.nam.kerala.gov.in) and send it to District Programme Manager, National AYUSH Mission, District Programme Management Office, 5th Floor, Arogya Bhavan Building, Near Ayurveda College, Thiruvananthapuram, by in person or postal, to reach by 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 40 years (as on 2026 October 1).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 15,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: GNM Nursing approved by recognized Nursing School with Kerala Nursing & Midwife Council registration.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Kerala Nursing & Midwife Council registration is required.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post is on contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Thiruvananthapuram.
